newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australis says subscriber base okay.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australis says subscriber base okay.

text.p: Pay television operator Australis Media Ltd said on Friday its subscriber base appeared to have stabilised but it could give no guarantee that it would obtain the US$250 million in new financing needed to ensure the company's future.

Australis, which earlier announced the largest 1995/96 net loss of any listed Australian company of A$251.7 million, said it had consent from most current bondholders including Merrill Lynch for the recapitalisation, subject to conditions.
